title: Adic direct-image finiteness between affine finite-type schemes
statement: Fix a prime l. For a scheme V let Qbar_l,V be the sheaf of locally finite continuous functions to an algebraic closure of Q_l: locally on V the values lie in a finite extension of Q_l. Let AdicSheaf_l(V) be the abelian category of modules over this sheaf, and call such a sheaf constructible if Zariski locally it admits a finite partition by locally closed constructible subschemes on which it is pro-etale locally finite free. These are the concrete sheaf models of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. Write D^b_c(V) for the objects of the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] which are bounded for its standard t-structure and have constructible cohomology. Let l be a prime and K an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from l. Let Y and T be affine schemes, let s:Y -> Spec K and g:T -> Y be locally of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let F be a constructible object of AdicSheaf_l(T). Then Rg_*(F[0]) belongs to D^b_c(Y).

proof.text: Embed the affine source T over the affine base Y into an affine space A^n_Y, using [lemma-nagata-quasi-affine-immersion-affine-space-exists], and compose with the standard open immersion into P^n_Y. Denote this quasi-compact immersion by j and the projection by p, so j followed by p is g.

Factor j through its scheme-theoretic image: j = j.toImage followed by j.imageι, as in [def-nagata-scheme-image-factor]. For an immersion, j.toImage is an open immersion, has dense range, and has the same affine source T. The image is a closed subscheme of projective space. Since Y is affine of finite type over K, projective space and its closed subscheme are noetherian. The image inclusion is proper and the resulting map to Spec K is quasi-compact and locally of finite type.

Apply [lem-sf-adic-dense-open-direct-image-finiteness] to the dense open map j.toImage and F. Apply [lem-sf-adic-closed-direct-image-finiteness] to the resulting bounded constructible complex and the closed inclusion j.imageι. The derived image along the immersion j is therefore bounded constructible.

Apply [lem-sf-adic-projective-space-direct-image-finiteness] to the projective projection p on constructible sheaves in degree zero. The already proved finiteLowerStar_of_bounded extends that assertion to every bounded constructible complex by the finite truncation triangles. Apply it to the complex obtained in the preceding step.

Every adic lower star preserves K-injective complexes because it is right adjoint to the exact adic upper star. The derived-composition isomorphisms therefore identify the successive images with Rg_*(F[0]); use adicLowerStarComp and the equalities j.toImage_imageι and j followed by p = g. Boundedness and the cohomology object property are invariant under these isomorphisms.
